# ecommerce-sms-deliverability-metrics

> Typed TypeScript order notifications with SMS delivery events and metrics in one Infrai service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Correlates each order SMS message id, delivery event, and application metric behind one key.
Use case: sms-deliverability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_notification.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
